Hello, I'm Faizaan Gagan, a Software Engineer based in Gujarat, India. I have been in the software industry since 2018 with experience in WordPress, RoR, EmberJS and Discourse. I was a full time freelancer and co-operative member @ [Pavilion](https://pavilion.tech) before I joined [Discourse](https://discourse.org) as a Tech Advocate. I am interested in full stack web development, helping out customers and Deep Learning. When I'm not working, I'm probably reading books on Islamic Theology, Metaphysics or Spirituality. Hardcore tea person. He/Him.
